summary: Cochrane 2015 calls the migraine evidence low quality after a 0.6 attack per month difference in the largest trial (16232154). A 2025 meta-analysis (41422534) finds a modest reduction with bias limits. MIG-99 failed in ITT in the dose study (12230594), and another crossover found no effect (23195074). The stored trial is dried leaf with no amount given. 300 and 380 mg flower extract labels, powder rows and plain herb rows were not tested at these forms in anything read. Stored positive_moderate overstates this.
